description: Sustain break across overlapping windows: fan_on at steps 0 and 1 starts hold windows 0..2 and 1..3. Both hold at s0/s1/s2. At s3 only window #o1 (1..3) is still open and the condition breaks there (cool=false, not fan_on): #o1 violated@3; #o0 already completed satisfied@2. This isolates window-lifetime bookkeeping. A second pairing where both open windows break at the same step is covered by Rust unit test sustain::two_open_windows_break_at_one_step.
